evidence: Upheld: the numbers are right and the comparison is fair. I re-derived both sides from their own frozen exact verifier files, both read by the same PK.audit near-touch: verify/frontload-lobe-stopb-knuckle-3r_corr_bench_frozen.json frozen.gap 22.82, audit.gap_near2 44.08 (34 poses < 2 mm, min 0.30, exact true); verify/sidecar-parallelogram-knuckle-3r_v_bench_frozen.json frozen.gap 19.13, audit.gap_near2 50.14 (44 poses, min 0.65, exact true), which equals remeasure/_bench.json deep.gap_near2 50.14. That gives plain +3.69 and 2 mm -6.06. The wording 'part of the gain is metal moved into the 1-2 mm shell' is loose: the plain gain is in-band 0.8546 -> 0.9049 (a 2-14 mm count, which 1-2 mm metal cannot raise), and at 1 mm this row is better (20.22 vs 24.46; min 0.65 vs 0.30). But 10 more taken poses graze at 1-2 mm (44 vs 34), and docs/ALIGNMENT.md section 1 counts that as metal on a real arm. So it is a trade-off the wearer pays, not a label. The level is report-only (A1 retired).

The row reads rows/sidecar-parallelogram-knuckle-3r.json continuity.full: static 19.13; connected_full 19.13 (0 of 120 forced-taken dropped, envelope env_forced_connected 490); connected_knn 22.21 (11 dropped, reach 0.6889); connected_bench 45.03. The knn loss is 22.21 - 19.13 = 3.08, above TH conn_gamed 3.0, and c_continuity (tools/alignment_audit.py lines 500-505) turns an ok full flood into a watch in that case. Measured; the number is now on file (remeasure/sidecar-parallelogram-knuckle-3r_msub_rest_bench_skeptic.json:family_reading {min 5.011, lt5 0}). I measured it on the claim's own wear, and the number is now on file. I re-ran tools/alignment_msub_rest_probe_model.py sidecar-parallelogram-knuckle-3r bench myself: model unchanged, row best_params, frozen protocol, CB_EXACT=1, nice, 385 s. It reproduces model_frozen.gap 19.13 (inband14 0.9049, reach 0.7194). Over all 369 taken poses, the family th reading (m_plain on the 222 rest poses, min(m_sub, m_eff) on the 147 K-open poses) gives min 5.011 deg and 0 poses under 5. The plain J1-J3 reading in the effective dyad, m_eff = th's distance from the fold of angle(J1,J2) / angle(J2,J3) as built, is >= 5.011 on every taken pose. The lowest poses are (135,30,-150) 5.011, (150,45,-105) 5.051 and (150,30,-150) 5.132. This matches the auditor's file docs/alignment/remeasure/sidecar-parallelogram-knuckle-3r_msub_rest_bench.json:family_reading {min 5.011, lt5 0}. The documented threshold is TH fold_min 5.0 (gamed below 4.95), so c_fold_margin on this number reads ok. The watch existed only because the tool reads row and verify files, not because the margin is short. Held-out margin: not measured (my held run was stopped at the time box). The claim is the bench v_gap. The 0.011-deg closeness is ruled under NEW-unpriced-stops.

This row is 25.5, and sidecar-longdyad-knuckle-3r is 25.5 with a mechanism record identical except notes and source. kneeless-sidecar-knuckle-3r is 28.0 (moving bodies 6 vs 7-2 = 5 after the knee credit, made 14 vs 16-4, bought 12 vs 16-6).
